title: Facet Policy Override v1.0
description: OPTIONAL per-project override file projects/{slug}/config/facet-policy.json, validated when present (absence = engine heuristic defaults). Lets an operator pin project-specific or non-English parameter vocabularies (Ticimax/Ideasoft/imagaza, Turkish 'sirala'/'arama', etc.) into the R-128 taxonomy; these classifications WIN over facet_nav_audit_transform's heuristic platform seeds. Additive standalone schema — no existing schema is touched, no migration. See rules/tech-seo-governance.md R-128.

schema_version.description: Schema version this override conforms to (rules/schema-versioning-discipline.md).

classifications.description: Map of query-parameter name -> R-128 taxonomy class. Overrides the transform's heuristic seeds for this project.

indexable_facets.description: Facet parameter names that ARE allowed to be indexable for this project (demand confirmed) — suppresses the R-129 'facet_filter indexable without demand' finding for these params.
